description: This file contains functions related to configuring Lantiq-based systems, specifically detecting system type (e.g., VR9 or xRX200) and setting up DSL hardware interfaces and modes (VDSL or ADSL).

methods.name: lantiq_is_vdsl_system
methods.description: Determines if the system is a VDSL system by checking CPU info.

methods.name: lantiq_setup_dsl_helper
methods.description: Configures the DSL hardware and network interface based on system type.
